# Taruvi Agents Plugin

Taruvi Agents Plugin packages reusable agent support for Taruvi projects. It
installs shared Taruvi skills and client-specific setup files for Claude,
Codex, Cursor, and Kiro.

Use this file as the agent-facing index for the repository. For human setup
instructions, start with [README.md](README.md).

## Installation

From a cloned Taruvi template, run:

```bash
npx @taruvi/agents-plugin install
```

The installer writes agent support files into the current project:

- `.agents/skills/`
- `.claude/`
- `.codex/`
- `.cursor/`
- `.kiro/`

It does not request credentials, create `.env`, or write local MCP secrets.
After installation, open the target agent and ask it to:

```text
setup taruvi
```

## Repository Map

- [README.md](README.md) - package overview, install command, and development commands.
- [package.json](package.json) - npm package metadata, scripts, and publish allowlist.
- [bin/taruvi-agents-plugin.js](bin/taruvi-agents-plugin.js) - installer CLI.
- [scripts/build-vendor-files.sh](scripts/build-vendor-files.sh) - builds the installer payload from source files.
- [src/shared/setup-core.md](src/shared/setup-core.md) - shared setup flow used by vendor-specific setup skills.
- [src/skills/](src/skills/) - shared Taruvi skills installed for supported clients.
- [src/vendors/](src/vendors/) - client-specific support files for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro.

## Skills

### taruvi-app-developer

Use [src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/SKILL.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/SKILL.md)
for Taruvi backend work: datatables, Cerbos policies, roles, users, buckets,
secrets, analytics queries, audited raw SQL, and Python function bodies that run
in the Taruvi function runtime.

Key references:

- [architecture-overview.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/architecture-overview.md)
- [mcp-tool-quickref.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/mcp-tool-quickref.md)
- [datatable-schema-patterns.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/datatable-schema-patterns.md)
- [cerbos-policy-cookbook.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/cerbos-policy-cookbook.md)
- [function-authoring.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/function-authoring.md)
- [function-sdk-reference.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/function-sdk-reference.md)
- [feature-workflow-examples.md](src/skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/feature-workflow-examples.md)

### taruvi-refine-providers

Use [src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/SKILL.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/SKILL.md)
for Refine.dev frontend work in Taruvi apps: data, storage, app, user, auth,
and access control providers; Refine hooks; list pages; dashboards; uploads;
permission-aware UI; and frontend calls to Taruvi functions or analytics.

Key references:

- [overview.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/overview.md)
- [database-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/database-provider.md)
- [storage-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/storage-provider.md)
- [app-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/app-provider.md)
- [user-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/user-provider.md)
- [auth-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/auth-provider.md)
- [access-control-provider.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/access-control-provider.md)
- [types-and-utilities.md](src/skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/types-and-utilities.md)

## Development

Build generated vendor payload files:

```bash
npm run build:vendor-files
```

Run the local installer test:

```bash
node bin/taruvi-agents-plugin.js install --target /tmp/taruvi-agents-plugin-test --force --allow-non-template
```

Run the package test script:

```bash
npm test
```
